features: Compatible Lightning Earphones for iPhone – Designed for iPhone 7/8/X/XS/XR/11/12/13/14 Series with Lightning connector, offering plug-and-play connectivity without the need for Bluetooth pairing or additional adapters.

Built-in HD Microphone & In-Line Controls – Features a high-quality microphone for crystal-clear hands-free calling, voice assistant support, online meetings, and voice recording. Convenient in-line controls let you manage music and calls with ease.

Hi-Fi Stereo Sound with Noise Isolation – Premium wired earbuds deliver rich bass, balanced mids, and crisp highs. The in-ear noise-isolating design reduces outside noise, making them ideal for music, movies, gaming, and phone calls.

Ergonomic & Comfortable In-Ear Fit – Lightweight, soft in-ear headphones provide a secure and comfortable fit for long listening sessions. Perfect for daily commuting, workouts, office use, travel, and online classes.

Durable Wired Earphones for Everyday Use – Enjoy stable, lag-free audio with a reliable wired connection. No charging required, making these Lightning earphones ideal for uninterrupted listening, video streaming, gaming, and business calls.
